title: 小鹏顾宏地：成本压力全行业共担，技术降本如何平衡？
speaker: Brian Gu

segments.en: I think when we actually have these agreements ready to announce, we'll be happy to share with Bloomberg. Okay, I will look forward to that. Brian, I want to get your take on just the overall macro backdrop, the environment that we're seeing across this AI boom.
segments.zh: 等协议准备好公布时，我们会乐意与彭博分享。好的，我期待。Brian，我想听听你对整体宏观背景的看法，以及我们在AI热潮中所看到的环境。

segments.en: You're starting to see memory chips, raw materials are getting more expensive, amidst what's going on.
segments.zh: 在目前形势下，内存芯片和原材料价格正在上涨。

segments.en: You have trade barriers that have been rising of late as well. Do you think X-Punk can absorb these costs, or are you going to have to pass on some of these costs to your customers now?
segments.zh: 近期贸易壁垒也在增加。你认为小鹏能消化这些成本，还是现在不得不将部分成本转嫁给客户？

segments.en: Well, I think it's an industry-wide phenomena. You know, it's not just limited to expanding packs.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为这是全行业的现象，不仅限于小鹏。

segments.en: So I think whenever this industry-wide phenomena, I think we will be acting in sync with other industry players.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，面对这种全行业现象，我们会与其他行业参与者同步行动。

segments.en: I think it is a challenging market, with all these costs, issues surrounding us.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一个充满挑战的市场，周围有所有这些成本问题。

segments.en: But I think we have actually shown a tremendous effort to really reduce impacts through technology development,
segments.zh: 但我认为我们确实展现了巨大努力，通过技术开发真正减少影响，

segments.en: really retooling some of our features, changing the product mix, et cetera.
segments.zh: 真正重组了一些功能，改变了产品组合等。

segments.en: So actually, we actually can see there is a way to really alleviate some of these cost pressures.
segments.zh: 所以实际上，我们确实能看到有办法真正缓解部分成本压力。

segments.en: So I think I have a confidence that it will be a balanced approach.
segments.zh: 所以我相信这将是一种平衡的做法。

segments.en: And I think also I will say we will observe and monitor how industry as a whole react to that pressure.
segments.zh: 我认为我们也会观察并关注整个行业如何应对这种压力。

segments.en: Yeah, Brian, because you're doing a lot, right? This whole full stack. You're funding robot taxis, human robots, flying cars.
segments.zh: 是的，Brian，因为你们在做很多事，对吧？整个全栈。你们在资助自动驾驶出租车、人形机器人、飞行汽车。

segments.en: All the same time, your car business has to help pay for some of these bills.
segments.zh: 同时，你们的汽车业务必须帮助支付其中一些账单。

segments.en: When do you expect that X-Punk can actually make its first full-year profit then?
segments.zh: 那么，你预计X-Punk何时能真正实现首个全年盈利？

segments.en: Well, the way I see it is that, yes, we are working on a number of technologies.
segments.zh: 嗯，在我看来，是的，我们正在研究多项技术。

segments.en: But the key thing is that all of these actually share the same core, which I think really provides synergy among the development process.
segments.zh: 但关键的是，所有这些实际上共享相同的核心，我认为这确实在开发过程中提供了协同效应。
